title: Brief: Add navigation to article detail view on tap
description:
## Problem
Clicking an article in the Brief view only triggers play/pause. Users cannot navigate to read the full article text like they can from the Feed view.

## Root Cause
`EnhancedQueueRow` wraps the entire row in a `Button(action: playItem)` which only handles audio playback. There's no `NavigationLink` or `selectedArticle` state.

## Solution
1. Add `@State private var selectedArticle: Article?` to `FilteredBriefView`
2. Add `.navigationDestination(item: $selectedArticle)` to navigate to `ArticleView`
3. Modify `EnhancedQueueRow` to:
   - Keep play/pause button on the left for audio control
   - Make the content area (title, source) tappable to navigate to article

## Files
- `Briefeed/Features/Brief/BriefView+Filtering.swift`
close_reason: Implemented navigation from Brief to article detail view. Tapping article content now navigates to ArticleView while play button controls playback.

title: Three-tier swipe: Save / Play Next / Play Now
description:
## Summary
Implement three-tier right-swipe gesture on ArticleRowView with progressive actions:

1. **Short swipe (~80pt)**: Save article (bookmark only, no queue)
2. **Medium swipe (~150pt)**: Save + Play Next (add after current item)
3. **Full swipe (~220pt)**: Save + Play Now (insert at front, start playback)

## Current State
- Single threshold at 100pt triggers save + add to end of queue
- `actionButtonsOverlay` exists but disabled (ArticleRowView.swift:434-481)
- `performSaveAction()` comment: 'Dont show action buttons'

## Files to Modify
- `Briefeed/Features/Article/ArticleRowView.swift`

## API Already Exists
```swift
// AudioPlayerViewModelV2.swift:360
func addToQueue(_ article: Article, playNow: Bool = false, playNext: Bool = false) async
```

## Required Changes
1. Replace single `swipeThreshold` (100pt) with three thresholds:
   - `saveThreshold = 80`
   - `playNextThreshold = 150` 
   - `playNowThreshold = 220`

2. Add enum for action tiers:
   ```swift
   enum SwipeActionTier { case save, playNext, playNow }
   ```

3. Update visual indicators:
   - Icon changes: bookmark -> list.number -> play.fill
   - Text changes: Save -> Play Next -> Play Now
   - Color: light green -> medium green -> bright green

4. Add distinct haptic at each threshold

5. Refactor `performSaveAction(tier: SwipeActionTier)`

6. Remove timer-based overlay (no longer needed)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Short swipe saves article without queuing
- [ ] Medium swipe saves and inserts after current item
- [ ] Full swipe saves, inserts at front, starts playback
- [ ] Visual feedback indicates current action tier
- [ ] Haptic feedback distinguishes tiers
- [ ] Elastic resistance beyond full swipe threshold

title: Mini player title has transparent background causing text overlap
description:
## Problem
The mini player title section in MiniAudioPlayerV4.swift has a semi-transparent background (30% opacity at line 43):

```swift
.background(Color(UIColor.secondarySystemBackground).opacity(0.3))
```

This allows the FeedView article list content to bleed through, causing article titles from the scrolling list to overlap with the currently playing title.

## Evidence
Text shows garbled characters like 'When a robot cAntellsAvou to lstop...' which is actually two titles overlapping:
- 'When a robot can tell you to stop, do you listen?' (current track)
- 'Anti-Aging Injection Regimen' (article in feed list below)

## Fix
Change line 43 in MiniAudioPlayerV4.swift from:
```swift
.background(Color(UIColor.secondarySystemBackground).opacity(0.3))
```
to:
```swift
.background(Color(UIColor.secondarySystemBackground))
```

## File Location
Briefeed/Features/Audio/MiniAudioPlayerV4.swift:43
close_reason: Fixed by removing opacity(0.3) from mini player title background

title: Play button has delayed UI response - main thread blocking
description:
## Problem
When tapping the play button, there's a 3-6 second delay before the UI responds with any feedback. Users don't know if their tap registered.

## Evidence from logs
```
Hang detected: 3.10s (debugger attached, not reporting)
Hang detected: 3.89s (debugger attached, not reporting)
Hang detected: 4.01s (debugger attached, not reporting)
<0x104296f80> Gesture: System gesture gate timed out.
Hang detected: 5.03s (debugger attached, not reporting)
WebContent process took 10.062241 seconds to launch
Hang detected: 5.94s (debugger attached, not reporting)
```

## Root Cause (to investigate)
The play button action likely:
1. Awaits network/heavy operations synchronously on main thread
2. Doesn't update UI state immediately before starting async work
3. Blocks main thread during article fetch/TTS generation setup

## Expected Behavior
1. Tap play → **immediate** visual feedback (button state change, loading indicator)
2. Heavy work runs in background
3. UI updates progressively as work completes

## Files to investigate
- AudioPlayerViewModelV2.swift - play() method
- UnifiedAudioPlayer.swift - addToQueue/play methods
- TTSGeneratorService.swift - generation pipeline
- QueueCoordinator.swift - queue operations
